trigger: Implementation-preceding structural review found that OPS-01 depends on SCI-07 while both belong to the broad cluster/mechanism/operations/governance phase, making a literal prior-broad-stage requirement internally inconsistent.

clarification.broad_stage: Stage labels are presentation groups, not permission to resolve decisions in arbitrary order within a group.
clarification.topological_order: Every prerequisite must have a strictly smaller TopologicalOrder than its dependent decision. Decisions may share a broad StageLabel when their TopologicalOrder still preserves the dependency.
clarification.acyclic_gate: The dependency graph must remain acyclic and every registered edge must point from smaller to larger TopologicalOrder.
clarification.unchanged: All 13 decision ids, 39 option ids, prerequisite edges, no-recommendation rule, blank default selections, external-evidence rules, human/public gates, and bundle membership remain unchanged.

interpretation: This amendment repairs presentation-stage wording before implementation; it does not use outcomes, choose an option, change a scientific dependency, select n, or authorize recruitment.
